info.title: Audio to Text Transcriber: Whisper Speech to Text
info.description:
Transcribe audio and video files to text with timestamps, SRT and VTT subtitles. Whisper runs inside the Actor, so there is no outside speech API.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/audio-file-transcriber
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/audio-file-transcriber
Author: Public Records.
